content:
Alex: Following the postmortem, here's a proposed ownership & rollout plan for the cache-eviction incident. TL;DR: assign owners, create Jira tickets, schedule staging rollout for fix, and track recurrence patterns.
Maria: +1. Can we split into short-term mitigation vs long-term fix?
Jamal: I'll take immediate remediation (short-term): adjust eviction thresholds and add a safety guard. Will own the deploy.
Pat: For product validation, I'll own acceptance criteria and post-deploy checks.
sre-bot: NOTE: recurrence analysis (90d) -> 4 similar eviction spikes; median time-between = ~18 days. See /ops/incidents/recurrence-report.
Alex: Proposed RACI (quick):
```
R: Jamal (implementation)
A: Alex (postmortem lead)
C: Maria (platform), Pat (product)
I: Eng-oncall, support
```
Maria: I'll create Jira tickets now. Plan: RED-9123 = cache: kv-prefix guard + config, RED-9124 = observability: eviction-rate metric + dashboard. Will link acceptance criteria to ticket.
Maria: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-9123 (will pop in linked PR after code)
Jamal: I'll self-assign RED-9123. Proposed timeline: dev (1d) -> staging testing (2d) -> canary (3d) -> full rollout (1d). If any blocker, I'll flag immediately.
Pat: For acceptance, please include: (1) zero unexplained evictions during synthetic load test, (2) CPU < 70% under normal traffic, (3) regression tests for hot prefixes. I'll draft the checklist and attach to RED-9123.
Alex: Also add an automated alert: eviction-rate > 5/min for 1m -> page SRE. We should backfill a 2-week dashboard to check for recurring pattern after deploy.
Leah: I'll schedule a follow-up review in two weeks and add it to the postmortem doc. Follow-up meeting ts: 1765003075.
Maria: Quick deploy command we'll use in staging for the canary:
```bash
kubectl -n staging rollout restart deploy/cache-service
```
Jamal: For the canary, I'll route 5% traffic for 24h, then 50% for 24h if stable. If eviction-rate triggers >3/min during canary, we roll back.
Pat: Please add product sign-off step after canary (Pat).
Alex: Who's owning the long-term work (root cause & architectural change)? We should assign separate ticket for that (sweeping fix + eval of batching/caching patterns).
Maria: I'll open RED-9125 for long-term architectural work and tag Eng-ML for eval. ETA to triage: next sprint planning.
Alex: Great. Summary action items: Jamal -> RED-9123 (owner, rollout), Maria -> RED-9124 (obs) + RED-9125 (long-term), Pat -> acceptance criteria & sign-off, Leah -> 2-week review scheduled.
Maria: Created tickets and assigned owners. Will update tickets with checklists and timelines by EOD. :white_check_mark:
Alex: Thanks everyone. If no objections, we'll proceed with the timeline above. I'll update the postmortem closure notes with ticket links and RACI. :thumbsup:
